_about: 银月的记忆是彩色的 (哇时刻 ③, Hanli 2026-09-29: 「可以，都按你说的，终章全彩」). Everything in the game is ink; only her memories are in colour — 工笔重彩 in 敦煌 mural colours, art/memories/ (tools/paint-memories.py), the one colour set (tests/memories.test.mjs). 一鼎一尾一段记忆: a memory comes ONLY from a chapter's key beat — the exit that brings its 鼎 home declares `memory: n` (rules/memories.mjs grantMemory); nothing else grants one. `tail` is the tail lit on the fox token (she has one; the first 鼎 lights the second). `say` is the one chat line (Ling's guide `tell`). `knows` is what Ling may refer to once it is unlocked (Look's `memories`), never before. `panels` are 1–3 colour pictures with her own short `lines` under each — shown in the main slot, blooming from ink to colour, and replayed from the album in 录. A memory with no panels is planned, not yet painted (doc/design.md § 哇时刻 ③: the draft prompts). The ninth (终章) turns the whole ink world to colour (`colour`: state.colour). `fragments` are in places (a place's `fragment`): ink with ONE coloured thing, found by exploring; the album adds a line for each.

say.en: The token lights its second tail.

knows.zh: 她想起九天之上，一道很亮很亮的光朝她劈下来；光里有个声音说：「天下，该归于一。」
knows.en: She remembers a blinding light from high heaven striking down at her, and a voice in it: “All under heaven must be one.”

zh: 九天之上，一道很亮很亮的光，朝本王劈下来。
en: High above the ninth heaven, a light so bright — striking down at this king.
There was a voice in the light.

say.en: The token lights its third tail.

knows.zh: 她想起青丘的春天，九尾俱全；一个凡人孩子举着一张饼给她——欠饼，是从那里开始的。
knows.en: She remembers Qingqiu in spring, her nine tails whole, and a human child holding up a flatbread to her — the debt of bread began there.

say.en: The token lights its fourth tail.

knows.zh: 她想起兜率宫：太上老君把那只小丹炉递给她，「拿去玩，别炸了」。
knows.en: She remembers the Tushita Palace: Laozi handing her the little furnace — “Take it and play. Don’t blow it up.”

say.en: The token lights its fifth tail.

knows.zh: 她想起很久以前在黑松岭救过一个猎人——主角的先人；这和吴婆婆的秘密连在一起。
knows.en: She remembers saving a hunter in the Black Pine Ridge long ago — the hero’s forebear; it ties to Granny Wu’s secret.

say.en: The token lights its sixth tail.

knows.zh: 她想起九鼎被聚到一处，青丘不肯交出自己那一口；天兵压在边境。
knows.en: She remembers the nine cauldrons being gathered, Qingqiu refusing to hand over its own, and heaven’s army at the border.

say.en: The token lights its seventh tail.

knows.zh: 她想起自己救过巫咸一族——所以巫姑看得见她。
knows.en: She remembers once saving the Wuxian people — which is why the shaman woman can see her.

say.en: The token lights its eighth tail.

knows.zh: 在石纽，她想起了斩她尾巴的那个人的脸。
knows.en: At Shiniu she remembers the face of the one who cut off her tails.

say.en: The token lights its ninth tail.

knows.zh: 她想起东溟的剑，八条尾巴落下；他要九鼎归于一人之手。
knows.en: She remembers Dongming’s sword and eight tails falling: he wanted the nine cauldrons in one pair of hands.

say.zh: 九鼎归位，九条尾巴，都长回来了。
say.en: The nine are home, and all nine tails grow back.

knows.zh: 九鼎归位，她九尾重生；灵境从水墨变成了彩色。
knows.en: The nine cauldrons are home and her nine tails grow back; the ink world turns to colour.
